top of page
Castle Peak Yurt
Nestled at 9,800 feet in Utah's pristine Uinta Mountains, the
Castle Peak Yurt offers an unparalleled backcountry experience. As the flagship hut of the Western Uinta Hut System, this fully renovated yurt provides year-round access to over 100,000 acres of wilderness, catering to adventurers seeking both solitude and excitement.
Book Summer
Book Winter
​ ​ ​ ​ Your Year-Round Backcountry Basecamp
​
Summer Retreat: In warmer seasons, the yurt transforms into a perfect basecamp for hiking, mountain biking, and paddleboarding. Surrounded by towering pines, it provides access to scenic trails and opportunities for sunset yoga sessions or hammock relaxation with breathtaking views. Choose between self-guided or guided and catered stays.
Winter Wonderland: During the snowy months, the Castle Peak Yurt becomes a haven for backcountry skiers and snowboarders. Its prime location offers access to untouched powder, making it an ideal base after a day of exhilarating descents. Guests can unwind by the fire, enjoy a chef-prepared meal, or relax in the cedar barrel sauna. Please note: all winter excursions must be guided and catered.
Accommodations & Amenities
​The Castle Peak Yurt comfortably sleeps up to 9 guests, an d is equipped with:
​
Wood-burning stove
A 3-burner propane stove
Kitchen utensils and flatware
Cozy sleeping arrangements bunk beds to sleep up to 9 guests
A cedar barrel sauna
Whether you prefer a guided, catered experience or a self-guided adventure, the yurt offers the perfect blend of comfort and wilderness immersion.
​
Guided & Self-Guided Experiences
​​
Guided & Catered Trips
Let our experienced guides handle the logistics while you focus on the adventure. Enjoy guided excursions, delicious backcountry meals, and the warmth of the yurt after a day of exploration. ​
Winter Guided and Catered Hut Trip- 3 Day 2 Nights
Based out of the Castle Peak Yurt or the Smith and Morehouse Yurt a guided and catered yurt trip is the perfect way to have an immersive backcountry experience while having a team of experts there to help you get the most of your trip.
What the trip includes:
2 Certified Guides
Snowmobiles to bump you and all your gear into/out of the yurt
All meal planning
All food and NA Beverages
Guide prepared meals
Exclusive access to the yurt
Custom Itinerary
What to Expect:
Day 1: Whether you head to the Smith and Morehouse Yurt or the Castle Peak Yurt our team will load your gear onto our snowmobiles and we will enjoy a scenic ride 4-6 miles into one of our yurts. When we arrive we will move in and then the real fun begins! We head out for an afternoon tour to get a sense of the snow and terrain. We return to the yurt as the sun goes down, enjoy some yurt cooked dinner and get a plan for the next day.
Day 2: The next morning we wake up to hot coffee and breakfast and new slopes to explore. We pack lunches and head out for a full day of backcountry bliss! We will skin from the yurt (or use snowmobiles to bump into adjacent terrain) and enjoy the endless bounty of backcountry bowls, glades, meadows and chutes. When our legs have had enough we return to the yurt where your guides have a warm fire going and apres getting served up followed by dinner.
Day 3: The final day we have breakfast, pack lunches and packup. Then we ski for the remaining 2/3rds of the day and return to Park City by 4:30PM.
Price:
3-4 people: $735 per person per day (plus tax and gratuity)
5-9 people: $685 per person per day (plus tax and gratuity)
1-2 people inquire for pricing

Western Uinta Hut System
Part of the Western Uinta Hut System
​The Castle Peak Yurt is a cornerstone of the Western Uinta Hut System, Utah's first and only four-season backcountry hut network. This system offers multi-day, hut-to-hut adventures with access to over 100,000 acres of terrain, including 96.17 miles of developed trails for skiing, snowmobiling, hiking, mountain biking, and UTV riding. The network currently includes the Castle Peak and Smith and Morehouse yurts, with plans to expand to five huts by 2027.
​
If you'd like to book a hut-to-hut experience , going to/from the Castle Peak and Smith & Morehouse yurts, please contact us directly and we'll help you plan your hut-to-hut adventure.

Frequently Ask Questions
We know you have questions and we're here to help!
​
New experiences can be exciting and scary at the same time. We want you to come into your experience with Inspired Summit Adventures feeling excited and ready, not anxious and unprepared. Review our general FAQ below, or visit our activity specific FAQ's for more detailed information. Not finding the answers you need? Just reach out to us and we'd be happy to speak with you!
Contact Us
General FAQ
How long is an experience/day with Inspired Summit Adventures?
Typically, our experiences are 6-8 hours depending on the activity, location, and client goals. We do not offer day activities as we believe a full day spent in the mountains is a day well spent.
​
Is transportation provided?
Yes, we can provide a door-to-door experience for those within the Park City limits. Our guides want to get to know you, and this gives us a chance to learn more about you!
​
Will lunch be provided for my experience?
Lunch is not included in any of our experiences (with the exception of camping/overnight experiences). We can provide lunch at an additional cost, stop along the way, or after your experience to show you our favorite spots for a bite and brew!
​
What happens if the weather doesn't cooperate on the day of my experience?
They say if you don't like the weather in the mountains just wait 5 minutes. That said, there are days when Mother Nature just doesn't want to play nice. Inspired Summit Adventures will communicate weather concerns with you, and will re-schedule or issue a credit should we feel it's not safe for us to proceed with your experience based on weather conditions.
​
What if we have other questions?
Like we said above, we would love to speak with you to address any questions or concerns. Please don't hesitate to give us a call at 435.640.4421 or email info@inspiredsummit.com .

top of page
We know you have questions and we're here to help!
​
New experiences can be exciting and scary at the same time. We want you to come into your experience with Inspired Summit Adventures feeling excited and ready, not anxious and unprepared. Not finding the answers you need here? Visit our General FAQ page ​, or just reach out to us and we'd be happy to speak with you!
Contact Us
Camping FAQ
Do I need camping equipment?
No. We have you covered. We supply everything from tents, sleeping bags, liners and everything in between! This is your chance to sit back and relax!
How does the food work?
Our guides are seasoned (pun intended) backcountry chefs and will work with you before your trip to customize a menu that fits your taste and budget.
What happens if it rains while we're out there?
Mountain weather changes quickly and storms do come and go during the summer months. When it rains, our team is equipped to create rain shelters that provide common space for hanging out next to a warm campfire. Rainy afternoons camping can be the most relaxing kind of days!
What should we bring?
When you book your trip we will give you a packing list for your specific area and time of year.
​
What if we have other questions?
Like we said above, we would love to speak with you to address any questions or concerns. Please don't hesitate to give us a call at 435.640.4421 or email info@inspiredsummit.com .

top of page
We know you have questions and we're here to help!
​
New experiences can be exciting and scary at the same time. We want you to come into your experience with Inspired Summit Adventures feeling excited and ready, not anxious and unprepared. Not finding the answers you need here? Visit our General FAQ page , or just reach out to us and we'd be happy to speak with you!
Contact Us
Climbing FAQ
What gear do I need to bring?
With our partnership with White Pine Touring , all gear is included (shoes, harness, ropes, belay devices, carabiners, etc.). You are welcome to bring your equipment which our guide will inspect prior to use to ensure it's in a safe operating condition.
What level do I need to be at?
Whether you're a beginner or seasoned veteran, we'll scale the objective based on your skill level.
What do I bring?
Yoga or hiking clothes. Fleece, raincoat. Daypack. Sunglasses. Sun hat. Sneakers to hike in on. If you have your own climbing gear feel free to bring that as well and your guides will inspect.
​
What if we have other questions?
Like we said above, we would love to speak with you to address any questions or concerns. Please don't hesitate to give us a call at 435.640.4421 or email info@inspiredsummit.com .
